items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] So what are you going to be, an Uncle Tom or a Smart-Ass? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, that's, you know -- the Uncle Toms can make it because they're controlled.

ctx.x: And I made a study of it. You wind up being called Smart-Ass.
So what are you going to be, an Uncle Tom or a Smart-Ass?

Yeah, that's, you know -- the Uncle Toms can make it because they're controlled. Yeah. And there are a lot of them, polished, but the inference is there, nevertheless. But go the other way and you're in trouble.
